source: Scans in Dropbox: Lung Block/Follia Non Ciamb/FOLLIA Reti (58 PDFs, 1940-1975)
method: Signed pieces (bylines, end signatures, photo credits, letters) read page by page from 90 dpi renders by Claude (Opus pilot, Sonnet batches); issue date per page from footer/header/masthead. Not the TOC.
letter_rule: Letter writers are kept only if they write in 2+ issues or already exist in network.db.

notes.Francesco Sisca: Signs 'Il consiglio del medico' as 'Dr. Francis Sisca'; DB node already linked to La Follia.
notes.Riccardo Cordiferro: Pen name of Alessandro Sisca (d. 1940). Review comment: 'Alessandro Sisca and Riccardo Cordiferro should be a single entry' -> DB node 1594 (Alessandro Sisca) merged into 1588 on 2026-10-25. Most appearances are reprints.
notes.Alessandro Sisca: 1964.pdf p2 '(ALESSANDRO SISCA)' is the subtitle under the Cordiferro title (subject), not a byline.
notes.Michael Sisca: Yes just make all Michael Sisca
notes.Vice-Simili: This appears to be an internal name, hard to connect to a real person.
notes.Teresah: This appears to be an internal name, hard to connect to a real person.
notes.Filomeno Argenio: Also printed 'F. Argento' (ScanPro0522 p2, Nov 1966): same West Pittston, Pa. subscriber.
notes.Thomas Bailey Aldrich: Printed 'I. B. Aldrich' / 'Adrich' over Crivello translations; original author.
notes.Giovanni Favoino di Giura: Printed 'Favoino di Giura' in La Follia; DB node 2141 (review; it.wikipedia.org/wiki/Giovanni_Favoino_di_Giura).
notes.Nando Rossi: Printed 'F. Nando Rossi' (1949 p1, Neapolitan sketch); 'Nando' = Ferdinando. DB node 1026 (review).

B. Z..question: Probably Bruno Zirato (6 issues; a letter beside one opens 'Mio carissimo Zirato'). Merge?

Sandro.question: Cordiferro pseudonym per one batch (1949 p13 dialect sketch). Merge into Riccardo Cordiferro?

VBM.question: Probably Vanni B. Montana (named in the commentary). Merge?

DB duplicate.question: network.db has both 'Riccardo Cordiferro' (1588) and 'Alessandro Sisca' (1594) — same person.

G. D. Procopio.question: DB has 'Giuseppe D. Procopio' (La Parola del Popolo). Same person?

Maria Vecchione.question: DB has 'Mary Liquori Vecchione' (poet). Same person?

Dora Tranchino.question: DB has 'Dora Chiaramonte Tranchino'. Same person?

Alberto Viviano.question: DB has 'Alberto Viviani' (Divagando). Same person or misreading?

F. Argento.question: One 1966 letter; possibly a misreading of Argenio.
F. Argento.answer: merged into Filomeno Argenio (same West Pittston, Pa. subscriber)

Initials.question: r. p. (Rodolfo Pucelli?), i. s. (Italo Stanco?), M. T. (Matteo Teresi?), n. b. (Nino Bellassai?), plus unresolved: A. C., F. B., G. B., L., P. P., S. I. M., a. m., e. d. g., t., E., GA., Dott. D. S.
Initials.answer: yes: r. p. -> Rodolfo Pucelli, i. s. -> Italo Stanco, M. T. -> Matteo Teresi, n. b. -> Nino Bellassai; other initials stay excluded

Translated foreign authors.question: Bayard Taylor, I. B. Aldrich (originals of Crivello translations). Keep?

Composers.question: Joseph Gioe, Guido Albanese, Alfredo Della Valle credited for music; one batch excluded a 'Mo. J. Gioè' credit in 1954. Keep composers?
Composers.answer: yes, keep composers (added 1954 p4 'Mo. J. Gioè' credit)
